title: 중요 감사 결과 등 보고의 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 중요 감사 결과 등 보고의 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to ensure transparency in the operation of the system for reporting important audit results, etc. and to enhance the effectiveness of implementing audit findings by clearly prescribing matters necessary for the operation of the system for "reporting important audit results, etc." under Article 42 of the Board of Audit and Inspection Act. <Amended on Nov. 2, 2020>
